lens: LENS 1 -- were they good trades, and would a wider stop have saved them?

verdict.one_line: A wider stop would have LOST MORE on every cell. 776C never traded at any of the five entry prices again after 10:20 and settled $0.01. The effect IS regime-conditional (trend likes width, chop hates it) but the regime is provably NOT classifiable at entry time -- this repo pre-registered that classifier on 2026-08-02 and it FAILED, and gap-go vs gap-fade (Tue vs Wed) is exactly the pair it cannot separate.

q1_did_776c_ever_recover.note: Post-10:20 maximum was an intrabar $2.00 print at 10:25 -- 6 cents BELOW the cheapest of the five entries. 'We need bigger stops' is FALSE for this day.

q2_776c_sequential_stop_grid.joint_reading: Down every column widening the stop loses more; across every row more entries loses more. Best cell = TIGHTEST stop x ONE entry (-6% x cap1 = -205) vs actual (-6% x 5 entries = -1196 modelled / -1279 broker truth). 84% of the loss is re-entry count, not width.

validation.claim: the -20% cell IS the live ribbon_ride premium_stop_pct

tighten_stability_minus6_vs_live_minus20.verdict: Robust to drop-best-5 and significant in aggregate, BUT the entire effect is pre-2026. In the recent window (2026 May+, n=49) tightening is worth +$15 -- indistinguishable from noise. Per J's recency>aggregate directive (2026-07-31) this does NOT clear a ship bar.

q4_regime_conditionality.effect_is_real_and_consistent: All three populations agree on the CHOP side: widening the stop is harmful. 391-day gap-fade (08-05's own archetype, n=30): -6% -120 -> -50% -2704, monotone. 391-day chop_like: +4504 -> -2423. 25-day book chop_like: -416 -> -1903.
q4_regime_conditionality.trend_side_conflicts: 25-day book trend_like +1231 -> +9555 (wider much better); 391-day trend_like +3466 -> +4534 (roughly flat/noisy). Different TP1 and different population mix.

evidence.killer: gap-fade true -> predicted gap-fade 16/44; gap-go true -> predicted gap-fade 18/71. Of days flagged gap-fade, MORE were truly gap-go. Tuesday 08-04 was gap-go and Wednesday 08-05 was gap-fade -- the exact pair the classifier cannot separate. The 776C entries were 09:58-10:19, squarely inside the blind window.

q4_regime_conditionality.conclusion: A regime-conditional stop is NOT shippable. Labelling it 'regime-conditional' without this check would be hindsight dressed as a plan.

q5_what_survives_both_days.on_the_stop_axis: NOTHING. No single static stop width improves both 08-04 and 08-05.

candidate_off_the_stop_axis.name: MAX-3-ENTRIES-PER-WAVE
candidate_off_the_stop_axis.definition: at most 3 entries per (arm, date, symbol) wave

08-04_gap-go_trend_day.note: largest 08-04 wave was n=3 -- literal no-op

candidate_off_the_stop_axis.why_not_cap1: 2nd entries are the BEST cohort in the book: +$1,070 on n=30. A cap of 1 destroys that. cap=3 sits exactly where the ordinal cohort flips sign (3rd +$107 -> 4th -$257).

honesty.concentration: 91% of the measured benefit is 08-05 itself. Excluding it, cap=3 is worth +$67 across 7 waves -- noise.
honesty.verdict: PRE-REGISTER AS A/B. DO NOT SHIP. Evidence is the day that motivated it.

mechanism_corrections.handoff_claim: 'Continuation setups have trigger_level=None ALWAYS, so their stop_mode=structure patch is a guaranteed NO-OP and they silently fall back to the raw -6% premium stop.'
mechanism_corrections.correction: For vwap_continuation this is WRONG in one load-bearing respect: it carries NO stop_mode declaration at all. strategies.py#VWAP_CONTINUATION is ExitShape(premium_stop_pct=-0.06, tp1_premium_pct=0.40, tp1_qty_fraction=0.8, profit_lock_mode='fixed') and ExitShape.stop_mode defaults to 'premium'. There is no structure patch on it to be a no-op. -6% is the DECLARED PRIMARY stop, deliberately ported 2026-07-09 (commit b1250556, STOP-B ship 2) as the 'full validated core cell' -- validated 2026-07-07, all 5 OP-22 gates PASS on n=149 real OPRA fills (OOS $75.47/tr vs $66.83, WF 1.62, anchor 82.04 vs 44.52). The 08-05 ledger confirms it live: stop_mode='premium', trigger_level=null, runner_stop == fill x 0.94 on all five entries.
mechanism_corrections.why_it_matters: This is not a config bug that can be 'fixed'. It is a validated knob meeting an adversarial day. The no-op-structure-patch story does apply to strategies that DO declare stop_mode='structure' while lacking a trigger_level -- ribbon_ride is one -- but vwap_continuation is not one of them.
mechanism_corrections.the_08-04_prediction_scored: The 08-04 audit predicted: 'The -6% stop on a chop day -- that is the treadmill, and it is the day we have not seen yet.' 2026-08-05 was gap-fade (chop-like) and the -6% stop fired 10 times for -$1,279. PREDICTION CORRECT.
mechanism_corrections.put_side_note: The 11:48 put resolved stop_mode='structure' (trigger_level 772.33) so its stop WAS the -50% catastrophe cap: runner_stop 0.825 = 1.65 x 0.50, and risky-3 exited at 0.82. Its TP1 is +100% (ribbon_ride tp1_premium_pct=1.0 -> 3.30), which the put's +59% peak never reached -- that is the mechanical answer to the TP1 question, owned by LENS 2.

caveats: 776C stop grid is n=1 contract on n=1 day. The -25% point estimate looks best but its Monte-Carlo p05 (-611 risky-1 / -977 risky-3) is WORSE than the -6% cell -- it rides a one-cent knife edge at the 10:20 sample and is NOT a robust cell.
The chart/structure cell for 776C is a RECONSTRUCTION: the live setup carried trigger_level=None, so no such level existed in production.

25-day book grid does not model chart-stop/ribbon_flip_back invalidation (inherited disclosed limitation), so its absolute dollars overstate; its -6% cell reads +815 vs broker truth +317. Rankings are the deliverable, not absolute P&L.
391-day sweep moves only 124 of 191 trades: the 67 structure-mode trades take the -50% catastrophe cap regardless of premium_stop_pct.
cap=3 benefit is n=12 removed trades across 9 waves, 91% concentrated in 08-05.

A first draft of the 25-day population tool hand-rolled the exit loop with no TP1 and no runner; every winner rode to the 15:50 flatten and the '-6% live' cell printed +$12,115 against broker truth +$317 -- a 38x artifact. It was caught and rebuilt on the live plan_exit_actions core. Recorded so it is not re-made.
